Sample is carbon nanofibre grown on Fe2O3 catalyst (XRD shows graphite plus Fe3C/Fe); reported yield 4.489 g per g catalyst per hour over 4 h implies carbon is the majority by mass. Not a review; not retracted (record.json is_retracted false); Table 1 values from other work are quoted for comparison only, while the 0.643 wt-% value is the authors' own.
